csv_scope_of_work: The Seattle Housing Authority (SHA) is seeking qualifications from qualified consultants to assist SHA with architectural design and related engineering services for building renovations, new construction, and demolition. Consultants will provide estimates, schedules, plans, and specifications, as well as support services including but not limited to: Electrical, Mechanical, Structural, Cost Estimating, Civil/Landscaping, and Surveying.

title: On-Call Architectural and Engineering Services
short_description: On-call design services for housing renovations, new construction, and demolition in Seattle.
project_scope: On-call consulting framework for the Seattle Housing Authority covering building renovations, new construction, and demolition projects. The scope includes preparation of estimates, schedules, plans, and specifications, plus related support services. No specific building sizes, gross floor areas, structural spans, or individual project technical characteristics are stated.
services: Architectural design and related engineering services, including architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, cost estimating, and support disciplines such as electrical, mechanical, structural, civil/landscaping, and surveying.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call services without a defined individual project or technical structure.
- Focus is primarily general building and architectural services rather than a specific complex structural assignment.
- Includes structural engineering among support services, but only as one discipline within a broad multidisciplinary call.
- No information on large spans, special structures, bridges, stadiums, or architecturally demanding landmark buildings.
- Such indefinite on-call building service procurements are generally of low strategic relevance for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is an on-call services procurement for multiple potential renovation, new construction, and demolition tasks, so no realistic single construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee, contract value, or estimated service volume is stated in the notice. As this is an on-call architectural and engineering services solicitation without defined task orders, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified consultants are sought for on-call architectural design and related engineering services for building renovations, new construction, and demolition. Requested disciplines include architecture services, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and cost estimating; support services include electrical, mechanical, structural, civil/landscaping, and surveying. No specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
